items.example: I thought today was Sunday, so I stayed in bed.
items.mnemonic: Соня устроил бедлам и остался в постели — stay in bed.

items.example: There was a long queue, but I brought you one.
items.mnemonic: Брат принёс тебе кофе — I brought you one.

items.idiom: drive to my old office by mistake
items.translation: по ошибке поехать в старый офис
items.example: I drove to my old office by mistake.
items.mnemonic: Водитель с мистикой поехал в старый офис — by mistake, по ошибке.

items.example: I didn't hear the alarm because I had ear plugs in.
items.mnemonic: Плакса спит в берушах — have ear plugs in.

items.example: Use linkers when you tell a long story.
items.mnemonic: Сказитель за шторами тянет длинную историю — tell a long story.

items.example: Remember to use linkers like then and after that.
items.mnemonic: Учитель с линейкой ставит связки — use linkers.

items.example: I missed my train and waited for the next one.
items.mnemonic: Пассажир с ватой в ушах ждёт поезд — wait for the next train.
